chunks: He raised the sky and set the Balance
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'Balance' (Mizan) mentioned in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Balance' (Al-Mizan) is interpreted not merely as physical equilibrium but as the comprehensive system of divine justice and moral accountability established for humanity. This verse underscores the cosmic order where every action is weighed with precision, reflecting the Shia emphasis on Adl (Justice) as a core principle of faith, linking the macrocosm of creation to the microcosm of human ethical conduct.
